# Step 2.228: the role-against-command test, whole

## Builder 1: allowed or refused, for the missing people and league states

What exists, all in `packages/database/src/stores/role-matrix.test.ts` (no command changed, no migration):

- 19 kinds of person against every row (was 12): added a registrar, editor and scorekeeper limited to one program, a coach and a captain. The coach's and captain's grant is moved onto the team the call is about (its `teamId`, the team of its `rosterEntryId`, or the home team of its `gameId`), so "their own team" is tried; they hold nothing a stage 2 command needs (P4 §4, T-500).
- Club admin: the database still refuses a club scope (0008); a test proves it, so it fails the day clubs can be given. The header now says this, and is true.
- Every row again in an archived and in a suspended league, as each person allowed in a working league: reads work, every change is refused except U-9's and R-26's (cancel an invitation, remove access, take a scorekeeper off a game, a name request for less, un-archive), written by hand (T-501, T-502). A separate test moves "Names on public pages" toward less (works) and back toward more (refused) in an archived league.
- Every `games.score` row in a league that scores assigned games only: the owner, a scheduler and the assigned scorekeeper succeed; a second scorekeeper without the assignment is refused on a call about one game.
- Broken by hand and seen to fail, then restored: a scorekeeper scoring a game not assigned to them, a coach allowed a roster command, a roster change succeeding in an archived league.
- Pending decisions T-500, T-501, T-502; T4 §12's row now names roles and league states.

Run and passed: the matrix (856 passed, 2 todo, 225 s, was 67 s), the other stores tests (30 files, 254), `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`, `tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs`.

Findings for the lead (not changed in code):

- `leagues.remove_draft`: our staff removed a never-published league that was archived or suspended; the command refuses only a published or used league. U-9 says read-only; the spec does not say whether staff may still remove such a draft. Marked `todo` with `FINDING:` in `stateFindings`.
- T-501 is a reading the spec does not spell out: reads that open a change (score sheet, tracker state and rosters, a game's format, reopen and put-back offers, the tracked box score grid, the season rules preview, the adjustments list) are refused in a read-only league, as the code does. If the lead reads U-9 otherwise, those are product faults.
- Refusal codes differ by command in a read-only league: "not-allowed", "league-read-only" (invitations), "illegal-transition" (publishing a suspended league), "invitation-not-usable" (reading a link).

For builder 2 (T-76, the fields each read gives): `runRow(row, actor, before, accountOf)` returns only the outcome code; widen it to hand back the result's value, write by hand per read command the fields each kind of person may see (P4 §4, T-76: a scorekeeper's roster read never has a date of birth), and add the done test's fourth case: break one read to give a field and see the matrix fail. The `readCommands` and `changeToolReads` sets list the reads.
